title: Find Wachira a Job — AI Portfolio & Red Team Lab
problem: Standard PDF resumes get ignored and don't prove live backend, streaming AI, or security engineering skills.
build: Built a Vue 3 + FastAPI monorepo featuring SSE token streaming (useStream), multi-provider LLM fallback (Groq + Gemini), <untrusted_jd> prompt-injection defenses (OWASP LLM01), sliding-window per-IP rate limiters, and an mtime-cached deterministic PDF resume pipeline (fpdf2).
outcome: Shipped a sub-2-second interactive portfolio where recruiters can interrogate the candidate's experience against any JD in real time without hallucinated facts.

title: AyuTech — Multi-Tenant E-Commerce & M-Pesa Payment Platform
problem: Local merchants needed an automated way to manage inventory, storefronts, and mobile money payments without manual reconciliation.
build: Engineered an async FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL (Supabase), SQLAlchemy 2.0, and Alembic migrations, paired with Vue.js/Flet interfaces and Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja STK Push webhook callbacks.
outcome: Automated end-to-end checkout and payment verification with strict callback validation and multi-tenant data isolation.
